<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/logs/{event_id}/payload"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the stored payload or body of one log record. Returns 404 if the record doesn't exist or has none. The content is masked unless a caller with the 'Unredact PHI' (logs.unredact) permission requests it with `unmask=true`; sending a message unmasked is recorded in the audit trail. `phi_masked` says whether masking hid anything in the payload sent.
